description: This line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10) performance metric for four different Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) configurations as the number of queries used during inference increases. The x-axis, labeled “# of queries used during inference (S).”, is linear and ranges from 2 to 8, with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10”, is also linear and ranges from 33.5 to 36.0, with tick marks at 0.5 intervals. The plot contains four lines: a black solid line representing “DPR w/o query” which remains nearly flat at approximately 34.5; a red line with circular markers representing “DPR w/ corpus expansion” that starts at approximately 35.1 and increases steadily to about 36.0; a green line with triangular markers representing “DPR w/ asymmetric expansion” that starts at approximately 34.9, rises to a peak of about 35.7 at x=4, then slightly declines before rising again to about 35.9; and a blue line with star markers representing “DPR w/ document expansion” that starts at approximately 34.9, rises to a peak of about 35.3 at x=4, then fluctuates slightly before stabilizing near 35.2.
